name: open-overwatch
description: The live Earth for Claude: earthquakes, satellites, launches, storms, wildfires, ships, transit, traffic cameras, cables, countries, weather and waves, aircraft, spacecraft and comets, the aurora, the planets and tonight's sky, with the 3D globe in the chat.
long_description: Ask about the live Earth and get answers from public open data (USGS, NOAA, NASA, Launch Library 2, CelesTrak element sets via the Open Overwatch website, Fintraffic AIS, CityBikes, Open-Meteo, public traffic cameras, transit operators, TeleGeography, Wikidata, the World Bank). Every answer carries a link that opens Open Overwatch's live 3D globe on it, and show_on_globe puts that globe right in the conversation. No account, no API keys, nothing stored.

tools.name: show_on_globe
tools.description: Open the live 3D globe on a view (in the chat where the app supports it): a place, layers, weather, a time, a satellite to follow.

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes worldwide or in an area (USGS), strongest or latest first.

tools.name: where_is_satellite
tools.description: Where a satellite or space station is right now (default the ISS).

tools.name: satellite_passes
tools.description: When a satellite passes over a place, and which passes you can see.

tools.name: launches
tools.description: Upcoming rocket launches worldwide (Launch Library 2).

tools.name: people_in_space
tools.description: Everyone in space right now, by station.

tools.name: asteroid_flybys
tools.description: Asteroids passing close to Earth in the coming weeks (NASA/JPL).

tools.name: tropical_storms
tools.description: Active hurricanes, typhoons and cyclones (NOAA NHC, GDACS).

tools.name: natural_events
tools.description: Open wildfires, eruptions, storms, floods, icebergs and more (NASA EONET).

tools.name: ships_baltic
tools.description: Live ships near a place in the northern Baltic (Fintraffic AIS).

tools.name: bike_share
tools.description: Live bike share stations near a place, worldwide (CityBikes).

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Weather now and for the next days at a place (Open-Meteo).

tools.name: aurora
tools.description: Kp now and ahead, and the chance of aurora at a place (NOAA SWPC).

tools.name: night_sky
tools.description: Tonight's sky at a place: planets, Moon, meteor showers, bright passes, clouds.

tools.name: traffic_cameras
tools.description: Public traffic cameras near a place, with the latest picture (London, New York, California, Finland, Norway, Hong Kong, Singapore and more).

tools.name: transit_vehicles
tools.description: Live buses, trams, metros, trains and ferries near a place (Boston, Helsinki, Norway, Austin, Minneapolis).

tools.name: wildfires
tools.description: Fire hot spots in an area from NASA VIIRS satellites, grouped into fires; named US fires with containment (NIFC).

tools.name: country_briefing
tools.description: A country's facts, area, this week's earthquakes, open natural events, nearby storms and the weather in its capital.

tools.name: submarine_cables
tools.description: Submarine cables and landing stations at or near a place (TeleGeography).

tools.name: solar_system
tools.description: Where the planets and the Moon are, how bright, when to see them from a place, and their next oppositions and elongations.

tools.name: eclipses
tools.description: The coming solar eclipses (2027-2030): where they are greatest, and what a place sees and when.

tools.name: distance
tools.description: How far between places, as the crow flies and by road, bike or on foot, drawn on the globe.

tools.name: volcanoes
tools.description: The volcanoes nearest a place, with open eruptions (NASA EONET) and this week's earthquakes nearby.

tools.name: road_speeds
tools.description: Measured traffic speeds on the roads near a place (Finland live, New York City).

tools.name: close_approaches
tools.description: The closest coming encounters between satellites and debris (CelesTrak SOCRATES via the website).

tools.name: reentries
tools.description: Satellites and debris predicted to re-enter in the next 30 days, each with its window, uncertainty and corridor (worked out from CelesTrak element sets via the website).

tools.name: sun_and_moon
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, day length, twilight, golden and blue hours, and the Moon at a place on a day.

tools.name: meteor_showers
tools.description: The coming meteor showers: when they peak and how many you could see from a place.

tools.name: plate_readers
tools.description: Licence-plate readers (ALPR) mapped in OpenStreetMap near a place in the US or Canada.

tools.name: military_areas
tools.description: Land mapped as military in OpenStreetMap near a place, worldwide.

tools.name: weather_details
tools.description: Pressure and its tendency, gusts, thunderstorm energy, fog, waves and swell at a point, and whether the ECMWF, GFS and ICON models agree.

tools.name: aircraft_lookup
tools.description: What a plane is (type, owner, photo) by registration or hex, and the route a flight callsign flies (adsbdb).

tools.name: where_in_space
tools.description: Where a planet, moon, spacecraft (Voyager, JWST), comet or named asteroid is now: distance, light time, speed, where to look; or every mission, or the comets best placed.

tools.name: airport_weather
tools.description: An airport's METAR and TAF (Aviation Weather Center) in plain words, its flight category and the runway the wind favours.

tools.name: sea_conditions
tools.description: The ocean buoys nearest a place (NOAA NDBC: waves, wind, water temperature) and the nearest US tide gauge with the next high and low tide.

tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Air quality at a place this hour from the CAMS model (Open-Meteo): AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2. A model, not a measurement.

tools.name: space_weather
tools.description: The solar wind and its Bz, X-ray flares, and SWPC storm watches and warnings (NOAA SWPC).

tools.name: dark_sky
tools.description: Light pollution at a place (Bortle class, SQM, nearest darker sky), how good tonight is, and the deep-sky objects within reach tonight.
